rows.grounds: compound of prāg-ukta (previously said) + viṣa (poison) + ādi (etc.); neuter plural accusative form

items.question: Which previously described poisons and related substances are excluded from this practice?
premises: The token names previously described poisons and their like.
It appears in a ritual instruction context.
items.inference: The rite excludes or sets aside those previously named poisons and related items.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role and governing verb are not recoverable from this single token.
items.plain_english: the previously described poisons and similar substances.
